shellCommands.command: git status --short; cat package.json; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.next -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50; find . -name 'ContactForm*' -not -path './node_modules/*'
cat app/ContactForm.tsx app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/; grep -ril "inline" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/ | head

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; grep -n -i -A3 "inline\|'use server'" 01-getting-started/07-mutating-data.md | head -80; ls 02-guides | grep -i form; grep -n -i -B2 -A25 "validation" 02-guides/forms.md | head -120
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -5; echo tsc=$?; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -15
